nom: ANUA KPop Demon Hunters Invisible Matte Finish Sunscreen

segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers describe the sunscreen as mattifying and not greasy, though one reports it turns oily again by midday.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including those with sensitive eyes, report no irritation from this sunscreen.

concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers with oily skin say it keeps them matte all day and functions well as a mattifying primer; one reviewer reports it stops mattifying and her skin turns oily again after half a day.
concerns.blemishes: Acne-prone reviewers report no breakouts, with one specifically contrasting it favorably to chemical sunscreens that usually break her out.
concerns.redness: One sensitive, acne-prone reviewer reports no irritation to her skin from this sunscreen.

aspects.libelle: Product residue caked under nails when scratched
Difficult to remove, needs double cleanse

extraits.texte: I had big hopes on this one… the texture is weird, like a primer, but that is okay. It gives you matte look, but after half of the day my skin is oily again! Will be returning

extraits.titre: I love the matte finish, but it's weird
extraits.texte: Overall I like the product because I really want a sunscreen that doesn't make me look and feel greasy before I even start sweating, but it sits on top of my skin in such a way that when I lightly scratched and itch on my cheek hours after applying the product there was sunscreen caked under my nail. Otherwise it's nice for the price, I will use it but I don't think I will repurchase it.

extraits.titre: An oily acne prone girls dream!
extraits.texte: This is my perfect sunscreen as an oily skinned, acne prone girly. I normally breakout with chemical sunscreen (even popular Korean ones like Beauty of Joeson), but this doesn't break me out. And most importantly doesn't make me oily. AND it actually works as a pore filling, makeup makeup primer. Tbh it works better as a maytifying makeup primer than a lot of other ones I've tried (smashbox, fenty), but dont it expect to be as mattifying as sowmthing like O/S oil sucker. I really hope this isnt limited edition.

This sunscreen is fantastic. I have oily, sensitive, acne prone skin. This hasn't broken me out or irritated my skin at all. It keeps my skin matte and looking fantastic all day. It doesn't irritate my eyes like most other sunscreens do. I love it. I will say, it's a little stubborn getting off. Just double cleanse

This is a great sunscreen for oily skin. It has a pump and I do enjoy that feature. I have very sensitive eyes and this doesn't cause irritation. I hope this is a staple in the Anua line as I plan to repurchase many times over!!
this is one of the best face sunscreens Ive ever used. It doesn't irritate my eyes and doesn't leave a greasy finish. Its soft and blurs the pores very well! Def going to be a regular for me now

reserve: Only 9 reviews are available, and most skin types (dry, combination, normal, mature) and several concerns (aging, dehydration, barrier, spots) are not addressed.
